about: Process sequences: ordered steps from a starting piece, through work in progress records, to a finished piece. Each step's caption is the artist's own note.

projects.title: Cliffs at another volcano ball lake
projects.summary: This is the first big drawing that I've done in a while. I started this process from another piece: the line art of the 2021 commission was inverted, used as a scribble source for Stable Diffusion, and the variations were layered and sampled while drawing new line work by hand.

steps.caption: Cliffs of Volcano ball lake. I started with this piece.
Took the line art from it and inverted it.
Generated several variations using stable diffusion. Variation 1
Used the variations as layers, sampled aspects of them while putting together the line art
About halfway done with line work
Getting closer and fixing up a few details
